chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 98: Li Huowang's Final Therapy Session—Reality vs Delusion
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang's last session with his doctor becomes a brutal debate on reality. Can his feelings for Yang Na be real if the world they live in is fake? The diagnosis isn't a cure; it's a devastating choice between two worlds.
og_title: Chapter 98: Doctor Li – The Truth Bomb Therapy Session
og_description: A brutal psychological cage match where Li Huowang must defend his sanity against cold, clinical logic. His only proof of the other world would risk dragging his loved ones into the fight.
twitter_title: Li Huowang vs The Doctor: A War of Sanity
twitter_description: In his final therapy session, Li Huowang fights to prove the hospital is a hallucination, but the doctor has one weapon he can't counter: the love of those he would have to abandon.
